maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem regarding the recurring cache-eviction spike. We need a tight playbook: exact triage steps, safe commands, who owns what, and deadlines.

kevin: I can own the playbook edits and open the PR. Planning a 3-step triage flow + command snippets.

sam: I'll add the root-cause notes about prefix distribution and KV growth and provide test cases.

lisa: Product asks for an explicit customer rollback and a flag to opt-in to a higher eviction threshold for Dedicated customers. Need that documented.

akshay: oncall here12 Manual mitigation during peak is painful. We should add an "approved mitigation" action that the oncall can trigger from the alert.

maria: Draft triage flow (proposal):
1) Verify symptom: `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (model) > 50` OR `model_kv_miss_rate > 0.2`
2) Contain: set model cache to read-only + scale pool if autoscale didn't act
3) Failover: switch traffic to quantized fallback if p95 latency > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes

kevin: Commands for step 2 (to include in runbook):
```
# set cache read-only for model
redwoodctl models patch model-foo --set cache.read_only=true
# emergency scale
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool model-foo-pool --add-replicas 2
```
PR will link to these snippets: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pulls/678 (WIP).

maria: Add exact alert queries and a short explanation why long-prefix traffic increases KV size.

sam: I'll paste the query and the short explainer into the PR and attach a simulation harness for the test suite.

akshay: Owner/time proposal: kevin -> runbook PR by Fri EOD (1719999900), maria -> verify + merge by Mon (1720172700), sam -> tests by Wed (1720345500). If blocked we escalate.

lisa: Add rollback snippet: how to undo `cache.read_only` and where to log customer toggles. Also add product notification template to alert flow.

runbook-bot: Created action RB-678 assigned to kevin, due 1719999900.

sre-oncall: I'll file INFRA ticket for "safe mitigation button" to run redwoodctl commands behind an approval gate: INFRA-1210.

kevin: Updated PR: includes triage flow, commands, alert queries, rollback steps, and decision checklist. Ready for review: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pull/678

maria: Final pre-merge checklist:
- [ ] kevin: respond to PR comments (RB-678)
- [ ] sam: attach harness and run test scenarios
- [ ] maria: smoke test in staging and sign off
- [ ] akshay: add automation ticket details and permission matrix
- [ ] lisa: confirm product notification template and customer rollback wording

kevin: Will ping reviewers Friday morning. Anyone want to co-own sections?

sam: I'll co-own tests and attach load scripts.

lisa: I'll add product-notify snippet and customer-facing rollback note.

maria: Meeting to validate merged runbook: Monday 10am PT. Please update the postmortem action tracker when you complete tasks. If something slips, escalate here. :thumbsup:
